title: Coder 2.6.0 before 2.29.26, 2.30.0 before 2.34.18, 2.35.0 before 2.37.10, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.6 contains a…
description: Coder versions prior to 2.29.26, 2.34.18, 2.37.10, and 2.38.6 contain a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability. This occurs because CSRF exemption patterns are matched as unanchored regular expressions, allowing some API routes to bypass CSRF token and same-origin checks. An attacker controlling a same-site page can trick signed-in users' browsers into sending forged POST requests that may recreate development containers or add users with specific names to organizations.
